name: maybe_Battle_ActionSubObject_BaseCtor
signature: void* maybe_Battle_ActionSubObject_BaseCtor(unsigned int arg1, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4, unsigned int arg5)
summary: Base constructor of the battle action window's six sub-objects: initialises a Gfx object descriptor (maybe_Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init with pool tag 4) and installs the family vtable 0x00763A48, which each subclass then overwrites.
evidence: The body calls the now-named maybe_Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init(...,4) and stores vtable 0x763A48, not a generic UI base vtable; its six callers (0x2DAE2C/0x2DAFEC/0x2DB120/0x3228B8/0x322B34/0x322C8C) are the same-shaped creators that replace the vtable immediately, so this is that family's base ctor. The old name claimed a shared UI-object base, which the concrete vtable and the Gfx descriptor init contradict.

name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateA
summary: Creates sub-object A of the battle action window: calls the family base ctor and installs its own vtable g_battleActionSubObjectVtableA.
evidence: The only caller is the newly named Battle_ActionAnimWindow_Init (0x2EC50C), which creates all six variants; A..F differ only in the vtable they install over the shared base ctor 0x322CC8, so the 'battle action sub-object' reading is supported by the now-named call site.

name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateB
summary: Creates sub-object B of the battle action window: family base ctor plus vtable g_002DB008.
evidence: Same shape as CreateA (0x2DAE2C) and called from the same Battle_ActionAnimWindow_Init (0x2EC50C); the vtable sibling set is now readable, so the family is confirmed.

name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateC
summary: Creates sub-object C of the battle action window: family base ctor plus its own vtable.
evidence: Called from Battle_ActionAnimWindow_Init (0x2EC50C) together with A/B/D/E/F and built on the shared base ctor 0x322CC8, which is what the name says.

name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateD
summary: Creates sub-object D of the battle action window: family base ctor plus its own vtable.
evidence: The only caller is Battle_ActionAnimWindow_Init (0x2EC50C); the sibling set A..F now has named callers, so the family is established.

name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateE
summary: Creates sub-object E, the variant with a larger default data block: base ctor, vtable g_00322B9C and three vectors copied from 0x007E7000 into words 0xD..0x12.
evidence: Called from Battle_ActionAnimWindow_Init (0x2EC50C) alongside the other five creators; the extra 0x007E7000 default vectors are the only difference from its siblings, which fits a sub-object variant.

name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateF
summary: Creates sub-object F of the battle action window: family base ctor plus vtable g_00322CA8.
evidence: Called only from Battle_ActionAnimWindow_Init (0x2EC50C); same body shape as A..E, all of which are now readable siblings of this family.
